newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MANCINI CLOSES DOOR ON INTER DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCINI CLOSES DOOR ON INTER DEAL.

text.p: Sampdoria captain Roberto Mancini, chased by Inter, listened to his fans on Thursday and announced he had turned down the Italian league leaders.
Mancini, who joined Sampdoria in 1982 and is the most prolific striker active in serie A with 130 career goals, told reporters he had decided to stay at the Genoa club.
Sampdoria fans had begged Mancini to remain with the team, beseiging him in a hotel where he was staying last week.
